tasks.text: The morning loaf went out light. Where do we weigh it?
A rye loaf was labelled as wheat. What has to be on the allergen label?
Someone filled the oven log after the bake. When is the log written?
A clerk changed a standing order because the bin was full.
The van promised a wide arrival. How long is a delivery window?
A cream cake went out in a paper bag.
The close used the screen total and the drawer was short.
A wedding cake was iced from a verbal note, with no sketch.
The night baker left before the morning baker saw the prover.
The waste sheet said about a tray. How is waste recorded?
A 16:00 order was pushed into dough that was already shaped.
A gluten-free tin sat on a rack under wheat flour.
The starter was fed whenever someone remembered.
A refund line said misc and did not name the loaf.
The board still shows last week's rye price.
One person boxed a three-tier wedding cake.
The driver reordered the van route after leaving.
A card slip ended up in a coat pocket.
A new loaf went on the board after a single good bake.
The door sign said sold out while loaves sat in the back.
An online order never left the slip and the pass saw nothing.
Spelt replaced wheat and the printed label did not change.
The prover had drifted and the dough overproofed.
A burnt-crust complaint sat until Monday.
The closer kept the morning's tips.
The fire blanket hook was empty at open.
A cake was baked although the deposit never arrived.
The driver opened three boxes to find the right cake.
Orders for the next morning close at four, and the dough is mixed at five.
Is rye still on the standing menu, and who decided?
